title: CREO: a repair-displacement term for population-based search, and the boundary of its usefulness
description: Raw per-run tables and analysis output for a within-host ablation of the CREO repair-displacement term: a constrained-suite campaign (29,760 matched runs), a shifted-optimum control (46,080), a moving-target control (19,200), a short-horizon replication, a matched-dimension replication and a rank-deficiency/plant-lag replication. Companion to the code repository github.com/alanvallavaraj/CREO-X.
